cards.title: Add your baby to health insurance
cards.body: You are likely eligible to add your baby to your health insurance outside the usual sign-up period, but only for a short time. Do this by 2026-11-02.

cards.title: Recall alert: KEAWIS Crib Mattress
cards.body: You bought "KEAWIS Crib Mattress, Dual-Sided Firm Baby Mattress" on 2026-09-10. Yixing Trading Recalls KEAWIS Crib Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Suffocation; Violates Mandatory Standard for Crib Mattresses (recall date 2026-01-15). Check the official notice and stop using the item if it is the same product.

cards.title: Dependent Care FSA: check with your job
cards.body: Some employers offer a Dependent Care FSA (a work account that lets you pay for childcare with pre-tax money). Check with your job to see whether yours does, and ask how long you have to sign up after your baby arrives.

sources.label: Dependent Care FSA: check with your job
